description:
`OctoPi.Coder.Tools.Bash` disabled `:kill_group` in Phase 3
because enabling it crashed the erlexec `:exec` singleton with
`{:exit_status, N}` on macOS. Without kill_group, `:exec.stop/1`
only signals the direct child — background jobs launched by the
command leak on abort.

Investigation:
- Reproduce the crash in isolation (minimal repo, erlexec only).
- File an issue upstream (github.com/saleyn/erlexec) if confirmed.
- Alternatives if unfixable:
  - Use `Port.open` with a small C helper that setpgid's before
    exec (custom port binary; ~50 LOC of C).
  - Use `exec` directly as an `erl_interface` port without the
    erlexec GenServer singleton.
  - Shell out via `sh -c 'exec setsid -w <cmd>'` to get a fresh
    session id; kill via `kill -TERM -<pid>`.

Acceptance: `bash -c "sleep 60 & sleep 60 & wait"` fully dies on
abort, verified by an integration test that greps `ps` for orphan
sleeps.

This is a rabbit hole — timebox to 2-4 hours. If no clean fix
emerges, document the workaround and defer to Phase 8.
title: Bash kill_group revisit — investigate + restore process-group kill
